en.t: Liu Yan declared himself emperor, establishing the state of Southern Han at his capital of Panyu (present-day Guangzhou) in southern China
en.s: Liu Yan (traditional Chinese: 劉龑; simplified Chinese: 刘䶮; pinyin: Liú Yǎn; Jyutping: Lau4 Jim2; 889 – 10 June 942), né Liu Yan (劉巖), also named Liu Zhi (劉陟) (from c. 896 to 911) and briefly as Liu Gong (劉龔), also known by his temple name as the Emperor Gaozu of Southern Han (南漢高祖), was the first emperor of the Chinese Southern Han dynasty, one of the Ten Kingdoms during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.

zh.t: 刘龑称帝，在中国南方番禺（今广州）建立南汉
zh.s: 刘龑（889年—942年6月10日），原名刘岩，约896年至911年间也名刘陟，曾短暂改名刘龚，庙号南汉高祖，是中国南汉的开国皇帝。南汉是五代十国时期十国之一。

en.t: Swa Saw Ke becomes king of Ava
en.s: Mingyi Swa Saw Ke (Burmese: မင်းကြီး စွာစော်ကဲ, pronounced [mɪ́ɰ̃dʑí swà sɔ̀ kɛ́]; also spelled Minkyi Swa; Mon: မင်ဂီဆွာ; 1330–1400) was king of Ava from 1367 to 1400. He reestablished central authority in Upper Myanmar (Burma) for the first time since the fall of the Pagan Empire in the 1280s. He essentially founded the Ava Kingdom that would dominate Upper Burma for the next two centuries.

zh.t: 明基·梭索开即位为阿瓦王
zh.s: 明基·梭索开（缅甸语：မင်းကြီး စွာစော်ကဲ；约读作[mɪ́ɰ̃dʑí swà sɔ̀ kɛ́]；亦拼作Minkyi Swa；孟语：မင်ဂီဆွာ；1330—1400年）于1367年至1400年间统治阿瓦。自1280年代蒲甘王朝覆亡以来，他首次在缅甸上部重建中央政权，基本奠定了阿瓦王国的基础；该王国随后主导缅甸上部长达两个世纪。

en.s: The Battle of Rapallo, was fought between Swiss mercenaries and their Genoese-Milanese allies led by Louis d'Orleans against Neapolitan-Aragonese forces led by Giulio Orsini on 5 September 1494 near Rapallo. Rapallo was occupied by 4,000 Neapolitan troops on 3 September 1494 with Giulio Orsini, Obietto Fieschi and Fregosino Campofregoso in command, their plan being to force a rebellion in Genoa. Later the Neapolitan fleet was forced away by bad weather. On 5 September, Louis d'Orleans landed with 1,000 Swiss mercenary infantry which was later reinforced overland by 2,000 more Swiss mercenaries and a contingent of Genoese-Milanese infantry.

zh.s: 拉帕洛战役于1494年9月5日在拉帕洛附近爆发，交战双方分别是瑞士雇佣兵及其热那亚—米兰盟军，以及朱利奥·奥尔西尼率领的那不勒斯—阿拉贡联军。1494年9月3日，4,000名那不勒斯士兵在奥尔西尼、奥比耶托·菲耶斯基和弗雷戈西诺·坎波弗雷戈索指挥下占领拉帕洛，计划以此迫使热那亚发生叛乱。随后，那不勒斯舰队因天气恶劣被迫撤离。9月5日，奥尔良公爵路易率领1,000名瑞士雇佣步兵登陆，之后又有2,000名瑞士雇佣兵和一支热那亚—米兰步兵队伍经陆路增援。

en.t: Conquest of the Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera (1564)
en.s: The conquest of the peñón de Vélez de la Gomera by the Hispanic Monarchy happened in 1564 under the command of García de Toledo Osorio. It succeeded a failed expedition the previous year, and resulted in Spain taking control of the place as a plaza fuerte, which continued up to present day. The reconquest of the place, previously controlled by Spain from 1509 to 1522, was a small but symbolic victory.

zh.t: 1564年韦莱斯-德拉戈梅拉岩堡征服战
zh.s: 1564年，加西亚·德·托莱多·奥索里奥指挥西班牙王室军队攻占韦莱斯-德拉戈梅拉岩堡。此前一年的一次远征以失败告终；这次行动使西班牙重新控制该地，并将其作为要塞据点，此后控制延续至今。西班牙曾于1509年至1522年控制此地，这次收复虽规模不大，却具有象征意义。

en.s: The siege of Velikiye Luki was one of the battles of Livonian campaign of Stephen Báthory. It took place between 1 and 5 September 1580, and ended in Polish-Lithuanian victory. Forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth captured the Russian fortress of Velikiye Luki. On 18 July 1580, King Stefan Batory called a council of his hetman, during which two plans were designed - either to march towards Pskov, or to attack Smolensk.

zh.s: 大卢基围城战是斯特凡·巴托里发动的利沃尼亚战役中的一场战斗，发生于1580年9月1日至5日，以波兰—立陶宛联邦获胜告终。波兰—立陶宛军队攻占了俄国要塞大卢基。1580年7月18日，斯特凡·巴托里国王召集盖特曼会议，商议两项方案：进军普斯科夫，或攻打斯摩棱斯克。

en.s: The siege of Jülich was a major operation in the second phase of the Eighty Years' War that took place from 5 September 1621 to 3 February 1622. A few months after the Twelve Years' Truce between the Dutch Republic and the Spanish Monarchy expired, the Spanish Army of Flanders, led by the Genoese nobleman Ambrogio Spinola, went on the offensive against the Republic and approached the Rhine river to mask its true intentions: laying siege to the town of Jülich, which the Dutch States Army had occupied in 1610 during the War of the Jülich Succession.

zh.s: 于利希围城战是八十年战争第二阶段的一场重要军事行动，从1621年9月5日持续到1622年2月3日。荷兰共和国与西班牙王室签订的十二年停战协定到期几个月后，由热那亚贵族安布罗焦·斯皮诺拉率领的西属尼德兰军队向荷兰共和国发动进攻，并向莱茵河推进，以掩饰其真正意图：围攻于利希城。荷兰军队曾于1610年于利希继承战争期间占领该城。

en.s: The Siege of Gloucester was an engagement in the First English Civil War. It took place between 10 August and 5 September 1643, between the defending Parliamentarian garrison of Gloucester and the besieging army of King Charles I. The siege ended with the arrival of a relieving Parliamentarian army under the Earl of Essex.

zh.s: 格洛斯特围城战是第一次英国内战中的一场战事，于1643年8月10日至9月5日进行。国王查理一世的军队围攻格洛斯特，由议会派驻军守城。埃塞克斯伯爵率领议会派援军抵达后，围城战宣告结束。

en.t: D'Artagnan arrests Nicolas Fouquet in Nantes on Louis XIV's orders
en.s: On September 5, 1661, d'Artagnan arrested Nicolas Fouquet, Louis XIV's superintendent of finances, in Nantes on the king's orders. Fouquet had been one of the most powerful officials in France. His arrest ended his ministerial career and led to a long trial and imprisonment.
en.n: The arrest in Nantes took place September 5, 1661; the later trial and sentence occurred on other dates.

zh.t: 达达尼昂奉路易十四之命逮捕财政大臣富凯
zh.s: 1661年9月5日，达达尼昂奉法国国王路易十四之命，在南特逮捕财政总监尼古拉·富凯。富凯曾是法国最有权势的官员之一。这次逮捕结束了他的仕途，随后他经历漫长审判，并被关进监狱。
zh.n: 富凯于1661年9月5日在南特被捕；审判和判刑发生在后来。

en.s: The Great Fire of London occurred from Sunday 2 September to Wednesday 5 September 1666, gutting the medieval City of London inside the old Roman city wall, while also extending past the wall to the west. The death toll is generally thought to have been relatively small, although some historians have challenged this belief. The fire started in a bakery in Pudding Lane shortly after midnight on Sunday 2 September and spread rapidly.

zh.s: 伦敦大火于1666年9月2日星期日至9月5日星期三发生，焚毁了古罗马城墙内的中世纪伦敦城，也蔓延到城墙以西。一般认为火灾死亡人数相对较少，但有些历史学家对此提出质疑。大火于9月2日星期日午夜过后不久从布丁巷一家面包店起火，并迅速蔓延。

en.s: The Battle of Derventa took place between the Holy Roman Empire and Ottoman Empire on 5 September 1688. It ended in a Holy Roman Empire victory.

zh.s: 1688年9月5日，神圣罗马帝国与奥斯曼帝国在德文塔交战，最终神圣罗马帝国获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Hudson's Bay, also known as the Battle of York Factory, was a naval battle fought during the War of the Grand Alliance (known in England's North American colonies as "King William's War"). The battle took place on 5 September 1697, when a French warship commanded by Captain Pierre Le Moyne d'Iberville defeated an English squadron commanded by Captain John Fletcher. As a result of this battle, the French took York Factory, a trading post of the Hudson's Bay Company. For other fighting in the region see Anglo-French conflicts on Hudson Bay.

zh.s: 哈德逊湾海战又称约克工厂海战，是大同盟战争期间的一场海战；在英格兰的北美殖民地，这场战争被称为“威廉王之战”。1697年9月5日，皮埃尔·勒莫因·迪贝维尔上尉指挥的法国战舰击败了约翰·弗莱彻上尉指挥的英国舰队。战后，法国人占领了约克工厂——哈德逊湾公司的贸易站。

Three weeks after the British Siege of Louisbourg (1745), the Wabanaki Confederacy of Acadia retaliated by attacking New England settlements along the coast of present-day Maine below the Kennebec River, the former border of Acadia. zh.s: 东北海岸战役（1745年）发生于乔治王战争期间，时间从1745年7月19日至9月5日。英国围攻路易斯堡三周后，阿卡迪亚的瓦巴纳基联盟发动报复，袭击了新英格兰聚居点；这些聚居点位于今缅因州海岸、肯尼贝克河以南的地区，当时该河是阿卡迪亚的旧边界。

en.s: The Battle of the Chesapeake, also known as the Battle of the Virginia Capes or simply the Battle of the Capes, was a fleet action which took place near the mouth of the Chesapeake Bay on 5 September 1781 during the American Revolutionary War. It was fought between a British fleet led by Rear-Admiral of the Red Sir Thomas Graves and a French fleet under Lieutenant général des armées navales François Joseph Paul de Grasse.

zh.s: 切萨皮克海战又称弗吉尼亚海角海战或海角海战，是美国独立战争期间的一场舰队交战，于1781年9月5日在切萨皮克湾口附近发生。交战双方分别是托马斯·格雷夫斯爵士率领的英国舰队和弗朗索瓦·约瑟夫·保罗·德·格拉斯率领的法国舰队。

en.s: The action of 5 September 1782 took place during the American War of Independence between two French Navy frigates, Aigle and Gloire, and a lone British 74-gun ship of the line HMS Hector. In a two-day battle, the two frigates severely damaged Hector and failed to capture her only when a British squadron appeared on the horizon.

zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，法国海军的“鹰号”和“荣耀号”两艘护卫舰与英国74炮战列舰“赫克托号”单舰交战。经过两天战斗，两艘法国舰艇重创“赫克托号”；英国一支舰队出现在海平线上后，法舰才未能将其俘获。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France between 29 August and 5 September 1791, the first national elections to the Legislative Assembly. They took place during a period of turmoil caused by the Flight and Arrest at Varennes, the Jacobin split, the Champ-de-Mars Massacre and the Pillnitz Declaration. Suffrage was limited to men paying taxes, although less than 25% of those eligible to do so voted.

zh.s: 法国于1791年8月29日至9月5日举行立法选举，这是首次为立法议会举行的全国选举。当时法国正处于动荡时期，瓦雷讷出逃及被捕、雅各宾派分裂、战神广场惨案和皮尔尼茨宣言都加剧了局势。只有纳税男性享有投票权，但符合资格者中实际投票的不到25%。

en.s: The Battle of Chantonnay (5 September 1793) saw Royalist and Republican French forces clash at Chantonnay during the War in the Vendée. In the wake of his victory at Luçon, Augustin Tuncq sent 7,000 Republican troops under René François Lecomte to occupy an exposed position at Chantonnay. Reacting to the threat, 25,000 Vendeans rebels with 21 cannons led by Louis d'Elbée and Charles de Bonchamps attacked and crushed the Republicans in a four-hour struggle in which François Séverin Marceau-Desgraviers distinguished himself. Only 2,500 out of 7,500 Republicans escaped the disaster.

zh.s: 尚托奈战役发生于1793年9月5日，是旺代战争期间法国保王派与共和派军队的一场交战。奥古斯坦·通克在吕松战役获胜后，派勒内-弗朗索瓦·勒孔特率领7,000名共和军占据尚托奈的一处暴露阵地。路易·德尔贝和夏尔·德·邦尚率领25,000名旺代叛军及21门火炮发起进攻，经过四小时激战击溃共和军。7,500名共和军中只有2,500人逃过这场惨败；弗朗索瓦·塞弗兰·马尔索-德格拉维耶在战斗中表现突出。

en.s: The National Convention (French: Convention nationale, [kɔ̃vɑ̃sjɔ̃ nɑsjɔnal]) was the constituent assembly of the Kingdom of France for one day and of the French First Republic for its first three years during the French Revolution, following the two-year National Constituent Assembly and the one-year Legislative Assembly. The National Convention was created after the insurrection of 10 August 1792.
en.n: French Revolution: The French National Convention initiates the Reign of Terror.

zh.s: 国民公会（法语：Convention nationale，发音：[kɔ̃vɑ̃sjɔ̃ nɑsjɔnal]）是法国王国时期存在一天的制宪议会，也是法兰西第一共和国成立后三年的立法机构。它接替两年任期的国民制宪议会和一年任期的立法议会而成立，起因是1792年8月10日的起义。
zh.n: 法国大革命：法国国民公会发起恐怖统治。

en.s: The Battle of Collooney, also called the Battle of Carricknagat, refers to a battle which occurred on 5 September during the Irish Rebellion of 1798 when a combined force of French troops and Irish rebels defeated a force of British troops outside of Collooney near Sligo Town.

zh.s: 1798年爱尔兰起义期间，法军和爱尔兰起义军组成的联军于9月5日在斯莱戈镇附近、科洛尼郊外击败英军。这场战斗也称卡里克纳加特战役。

en.s: The Jourdan Law of 5 September 1798 (French: loi Jourdan-Delbrel) effectively institutionalised conscription in Revolutionary France, which began with the levée en masse. It stipulated that all single and childless men between the ages of 20 and 25 were liable for military service. Exemptions existed however for the clergy, industrial workers essential for the war effort, students from selected Grandes écoles (higher-education institutions), and public office holders.

zh.s: 1798年9月5日颁布的《茹尔当法》（法文：loi Jourdan-Delbrel）在法国大革命时期确立了征兵制度，该制度始于“全民动员令”。法律规定，20至25岁的未婚且无子女男性须服兵役。神职人员、对战争至关重要的产业工人、部分高等院校的学生及公职人员可获豁免。

en.s: The Battle of Varvarin (Serbian Cyrillic: Варваринска битка) was fought on 5 September 1810 between Serbian Revolutionary forces supported by Russian troops and Ottoman forces near Varvarin, at the time part of the Ottoman Empire, (today Serbia). During the 10-hour battle, the Turkish army unsuccessfully attacked the Russians and Serbs, but was never able to push them out of their positions, retreating in the evening with heavy casualties.

zh.s: 1810年9月5日，塞尔维亚革命军在俄军支援下，与奥斯曼军队在瓦尔瓦林附近交战。当时该地属于奥斯曼帝国，现属塞尔维亚。十小时的战斗中，土耳其军队多次进攻俄军和塞尔维亚军队，但始终没能将他们赶出阵地，最终在傍晚伤亡惨重地撤退。

en.s: The siege of Fort Wayne took place from September 5–12, 1812, during the War of 1812. The stand-off occurred in the modern city of Fort Wayne, Indiana, between the U.S. military garrison at Fort Wayne and a combined force of Potawatomi and Miami forces. The conflict began when warriors under the Potawatomi chiefs Winamac and Five Medals killed two members of the U.S. garrison.

zh.s: 1812年9月5日至12日，1812年战争期间发生了韦恩堡围城战。交战地点在今天的印第安纳州韦恩堡，双方是韦恩堡的美国驻军和波塔瓦托米人与迈阿密人的联军。波塔瓦托米酋长威纳马克和五枚勋章率领的战士杀死两名美国驻军成员后，冲突爆发。

en.s: The capture of HMS Boxer in 1813 was a sea fight off the coast of Maine in the War of 1812. The United States Navy brig USS Enterprise, commanded by Lieutenant William Burrows, defeated the Royal Navy gun-brig HMS Boxer, led by Commander Samuel Blyth. Constructed as a schooner in Maryland in 1799, the victorious American was rebuilt as a brig prior to the war.

zh.t: 俘获英国皇家海军“拳击手号”
zh.s: 1813年1812年战争期间，美国海军双桅横帆船“企业号”在缅因州海岸附近海域击败英国皇家海军炮舰“拳击手号”。“企业号”由威廉·伯罗斯中尉指挥；“拳击手号”由塞缪尔·布莱思指挥。获胜的美国舰艇最初于1799年在马里兰建成，原为纵帆船，战前改装成双桅横帆船。

en.s: The 1836 Republic of Texas presidential election was the first such election in the newly established Republic of Texas. Popular war hero Samuel Houston was elected in a decisive victory over Henry Smith and Stephen F. Austin. Houston was inaugurated on October 22, 1836, replacing interim president David G. Burnet.

zh.t: 1836年德克萨斯共和国总统选举
zh.s: 1836年德克萨斯共和国总统选举是这个新成立的共和国首次举行的总统选举。广受欢迎的战争英雄塞缪尔·休斯敦大胜亨利·史密斯和斯蒂芬·F·奥斯汀，当选总统。休斯敦于1836年10月22日宣誓就职，接替临时总统戴维·G·伯内特。

en.s: The 1837 Vermont gubernatorial election was held on September 5, 1837. Incumbent Whig Governor Silas H. Jennison defeated Democratic nominee William Czar Bradley with 55.65% of the vote.

en.s: The Battle of Spokane Plains was a battle during the Coeur d'Alene War of 1858 in the Washington Territory (now the states of Washington and Idaho) in the United States. The Coeur d'Alene War was part of the Yakima War, which began in 1855. The battle was fought west of Fort George Wright near Spokane, Washington, between elements of the United States Army and a coalition of Native American tribes consisting of Kalispel (Pend Oreille), Palus, Schitsu'umsh (Coeur d'Alene), Spokan, and Yakama warriors.

zh.s: 斯波坎平原战役是1858年科达伦战争期间发生的一场战斗，地点在美国华盛顿领地（今华盛顿州和爱达荷州）。科达伦战争是1855年开始的雅基马战争的一部分。战斗发生在华盛顿州斯波坎附近、乔治·赖特堡以西，交战双方是美国陆军部队和由卡利斯佩尔（彭德奥雷）、帕卢斯、希楚乌姆什（科达伦）、斯波坎及雅基马战士组成的美洲原住民部族联军。

en.s: The Battle of Anqing (安慶之戰) was a prolonged siege of the prefecture-level city of Anqing in Anhui, China, initiated by Hunan Army forces loyal to the Qing Dynasty against the armies of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. The siege began in September 1860 and ended on September 5, 1861, when imperial forces under the command of Zeng Guoquan breached the walls of the city and occupied it.

From September 3-5, 1863, Brigadier General Alfred Sully led U.S. Army troops against a village of Yanktonai, Santee, and Teton (Lakota) Sioux.

en.s: On 5 September 1887, a fire broke out in the backstage area of the Theatre Royal in Exeter, England, during the production of The Romany Rye. The fire caused panic throughout the theatre, with 186 people dying from a combination of the direct effects of smoke and flame, crushing and trampling, and trauma injuries from falling or jumping from the roof and balconies. The death toll makes it the worst theatre disaster, the worst single-building fire, and the third worst fire-related disaster in UK history.

zh.s: 1887年9月5日，英国埃克塞特的皇家剧院正在演出《吉卜赛小伙》时，后台起火。火灾在剧院内引发恐慌，186人因吸入烟雾、被火焰灼伤、挤压踩踏，或从屋顶和阳台坠落、跳下而受伤致死。按死亡人数计算，这是英国最严重的剧院灾难、最严重的单体建筑火灾，也是英国第三严重的火灾事故。

en.s: The Treaty of Portsmouth formally ended the 1904–1905 Russo-Japanese War. It was signed on September 5, 1905, after negotiations from August 6 to 30, at the Portsmouth Naval Shipyard in Kittery, Maine (then part of Portsmouth, New Hampshire), United States. U.S. President Theodore Roosevelt was instrumental in the negotiations and won the Nobel Peace Prize for his efforts, the first ever American recipient. The treaty recognized Japan's hegemony in Korea (which soon after became a protectorate of the Empire of Japan), awarded it Russia's lease on the Liaodong Peninsula (which became the Kwantung Leased Territory), control of the Russian-built South Manchuria Railway, and the southern half of the island of Sakhalin (Karafuto).

zh.s: 朴茨茅斯条约正式结束了1904至1905年的日俄战争。双方于1905年8月6日至30日进行谈判，随后于9月5日在美国缅因州基特里镇的朴茨茅斯海军造船厂签署条约；当时基特里镇属于新罕布什尔州朴茨茅斯市。美国总统西奥多·罗斯福在谈判中发挥了关键作用，并因促成和约获得诺贝尔和平奖，是首位获此奖的美国人。条约承认日本对朝鲜的霸权（朝鲜不久后成为日本帝国的保护国），将俄罗斯在辽东半岛的租借权益、俄国修建的南满铁路控制权以及库页岛南部割让给日本；辽东半岛由此成为关东州。

en.s: The 1909 Tie Cup final was the final match to decide the winner of the Tie Cup, the 10th edition of the international competition organised by the Argentine and Uruguayan Associations together. The final was contested by Argentine Alumni and Uruguayan CURCC. In the match, played at Estadio GEBA in Palermo, Buenos Aires, Alumni beat CURCC 4–0, with goals by Eliseo Brown (3) and Alfredo Brown, achieving not only its sixth Tie Cup trophy but the record of titles won by any team.

en.s: The 1910 FA Charity Shield was the third Charity Shield, a football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Football League and Southern League competitions. The match was played at Stamford Bridge, London, and ended with a 1–0 win for Brighton and Hove Albion.

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 5 September 1914. The election had been called before the declaration of war in August 1914. All 75 seats in the House of Representatives, and all 36 seats in the Senate were up for election in a double dissolution. The incumbent Commonwealth Liberal Party led by Prime Minister of Australia Joseph Cook was defeated by the opposition Australian Labor Party led by Andrew Fisher. Until the defeat of the Howard Government in 2007, the Cook Government was the only non-Labor Government in Australian history that did not last longer than the Labor Government it had replaced.

en.s: The Great Retreat (French: Grande Retraite), also known as the retreat from Mons, took place in the First World War. en.s: On September 5, 1937, Tipperary beat Kilkenny 3–11 to 0–3 in the All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship final at Fitzgerald Stadium in Killarney, County Kerry. The match decided the 1937 national hurling title. It was held in Killarney rather than at Dublin's Croke Park.

zh.s: 1937年9月5日，蒂珀雷里队在爱尔兰凯里郡基拉尼的菲茨杰拉德体育场，以3比11对0比3击败基尔肯尼队，夺得当年的全爱尔兰高级板棍球锦标赛冠军。这场决赛没有在通常的都柏林克罗克公园举行，而是移师基拉尼。

en.s: The Seguro Obrero massacre (Spanish: Matanza del Seguro Obrero, lit. 'Workers Insurance's Massacre') occurred on 5 September 1938, and was the Chilean government's response to an attempted coup d'état by the National Socialist Movement of Chile (MNSCh), whose members were known at the time as Nacistas ("Nazis"). Known for their affinity towards violence in order to attain their goals, their occupation of the central building at the University of Chile and the Seguro Obrero building was responded to quickly and harshly by the Chilean government and the carabineros.

zh.s: 劳工保险大楼大屠杀（西班牙语：Matanza del Seguro Obrero，意为“劳工保险大楼屠杀”）发生于1938年9月5日，是智利政府对智利国家社会主义运动（MNSCh）未遂政变的回应。该组织成员当时被称为“纳粹党人”。他们占领了智利大学中央大楼和劳工保险大楼；智利政府和宪兵队以迅速而强硬的方式作出回应。

en.s: The Finnish invasion of the Karelian Isthmus refers to a military campaign carried out by Finland in 1941. It was part of what is commonly referred to as the Continuation War. en.s: The Battle of Alam el Halfa took place between 30 August and 5 September 1942 south of El Alamein during the Western Desert Campaign of the Second World War. Panzerarmee Afrika (Generalfeldmarschall Erwin Rommel), attempted an envelopment of the British Eighth Army (Lieutenant-General Bernard Montgomery). In Unternehmen Brandung (Operation Surf), the last big Axis offensive of the Western Desert Campaign, Rommel intended to defeat the Eighth Army before Allied reinforcements arrived.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战西部沙漠战役期间，阿拉姆哈勒法战役于1942年8月30日至9月5日在阿拉曼以南进行。由陆军元帅埃尔温·隆美尔指挥的非洲装甲集团军试图包围伯纳德·蒙哥马利中将率领的英国第八集团军。隆美尔在“冲浪行动”中发动西部沙漠战役的最后一次大型轴心国攻势，意图在盟军增援抵达前击败第八集团军。

en.s: The First Battle of Eora Creek–Templeton's Crossing was fought from 31 August 1942 to 5 September 1942. en.s: The Landing at Nadzab was an airborne landing on 5 September 1943 during the New Guinea campaign of World War II in conjunction with the landing at Lae. en.t: Robert Schuman begins a brief second term as France's prime minister
en.s: On September 5, 1948, Robert Schuman began a second, short term as France's president of the Council of Ministers, the role then equivalent to prime minister. He also held the foreign affairs portfolio. He had previously led a government from 1947 to July 1948 and continued to shape French foreign policy after this brief second administration.

zh.t: 罗贝尔·舒曼短暂第二次出任法国总理

en.t: Attempted assassination of Gerald Ford in Sacramento
en.s: On September 5, 1975, Lynette "Squeaky" Fromme, a member of the Manson Family cult, attempted to assassinate President of the United States Gerald Ford in Sacramento, California. Fromme, who was standing a little more than an arm's length from Ford, pointed a M1911 pistol at him in the public grounds of the California State Capitol building and without chambering a round in the gun, unsuccessfully attempted to fire. After the assassination attempt, Ford continued to walk to the California state house, where he met with Governor Jerry Brown. For her crime, Fromme spent 34 years in prison and was released on August 14, 2009—two years and seven months after Ford's death.

en.s: The battle of Maaten al-Sarra was a battle fought between Chad and Libya on September 5, 1987 during the Toyota War. The battle took the form of a surprise Chadian raid against the Libyan Maaten al-Sarra Air Base, meant to remove the threat of Libyan airpower, that had already thwarted the Chadian attack on the Aouzou Strip in August. The first clash ever held in Libyan territory since the beginning of the Chadian-Libyan conflict, the attack was fully successful, causing a high number of Libyan casualties and low Chadian casualties, also contributing to the definitive ceasefire signed on September 11 among the warring countries.

zh.s: 马阿坦·萨拉战役是乍得和利比亚于1987年9月5日在丰田战争期间发生的一场战斗。乍得军队突袭了利比亚的马阿坦·萨拉空军基地，意在消除利比亚空中力量的威胁；此前，利比亚空中力量曾挫败乍得8月对奥祖地带的进攻。这是乍得—利比亚冲突爆发以来首次在利比亚境内发生的交战。突袭大获成功，利比亚伤亡惨重，乍得方面伤亡较轻，并促成了交战国家于9月11日签署最终停火协议。

en.t: Argentina v Colombia (1994 FIFA World Cup qualification)
en.s: The qualifying match for the 1994 FIFA World Cup between Argentina and Colombia is a historic football match played on September 5, 1993. It was the last day of qualifying matches in the group A of the South American qualifiers. Argentina, in that time second of the group, needed to win in order to not play the intercontinental play-off against Australia. If Argentina didn't win, the qualification to the World Cup depended on the result of the other match of the group (being held in Lima in the same day) between Peru and Paraguay.

en.s: Hurricane Fran caused extensive damage in the United States in early September 1996. The sixth named storm, fifth hurricane, and third major hurricane of the 1996 Atlantic hurricane season, Fran developed from a tropical wave near Cape Verde on August 23. Due to nearby Hurricane Edouard, the depression remained disorganized as it tracked westward, though it eventually intensified into Tropical Storm Fran on August 27.
en.n: Hurricane Fran makes landfall near Cape Fear, North Carolina as a Category 3 storm with 115 mph sustained winds. Fran caused over $3 billion in damage and killed 27 people.

zh.s: 2012年9月5日当地时间21时15分，土耳其阿菲永卡拉希萨尔发生军火库爆炸。据土耳其武装部队称，事故造成25名军人死亡，另有4名士兵和3名平民受伤。爆炸后现场起火，火势扑灭后找到两名士官、两名特务军士和21名列兵的遗体。

en.t: TNA tapes One Night Only: Turning Point in Charlottesville
en.s: On September 5, 2014, Total Nonstop Action Wrestling taped its One Night Only: Turning Point show at John Paul Jones Arena in Charlottesville, Virginia. The matches were recorded in front of an audience that night, then released as a pay-per-view program on January 9, 2015. en.t: Afghan forces retake Janikhel district from the Taliban
en.s: On September 5, 2016, Afghan government forces retook Janikhel district in Paktia province from the Taliban after days of fighting. The Taliban had overrun the district in late August. Government reinforcements and air support helped drive the militants from the district centre, although the wider area remained contested.
en.n: Janikhel district was retaken on September 5, 2016; the Taliban had captured it on August 27.

zh.t: 阿富汗政府军从塔利班手中夺回贾尼海勒区
zh.s: 2016年9月5日，阿富汗政府军经过数日交战，从塔利班手中夺回帕克蒂亚省贾尼海勒区。塔利班在8月底曾攻占该区。政府军增援部队在空中支援下夺回区中心，但周边地区的争夺并未因此结束。
zh.n: 政府军于2016年9月5日夺回贾尼海勒区；塔利班此前在8月27日攻占该区。

en.s: The 2018 Slovakia v Denmark football match was an international friendly association football match between the senior national teams of Slovakia and Denmark. The match took place on 5 September 2018 at the Anton Malatinský Stadium in Trnava, Slovakia.

en.s: On 5 September 2020, was a rugby union match played between provinces on the North Island and the South Island of New Zealand. zh.t: 2020年新西兰北岛对南岛橄榄球赛
zh.s: 2020年9月5日，新西兰北岛和南岛各省代表队进行了一场橄榄球赛。这是两岛之间的第81场比赛，也是继2012年为奥塔哥橄榄球联盟筹款的单场比赛之后，第二次举行这样的单场赛。2012年那场比赛中，南岛队在但尼丁福赛斯巴尔球场以32比24获胜。

en.s: On 5 September 2021, President of Guinea Alpha Condé was captured by the country's armed forces in a coup d'état after gunfire in the capital, Conakry. Special forces commander Mamady Doumbouya released a broadcast on state television announcing the dissolution of the constitution and government. After several decades of authoritarian rule in Guinea, Condé was the country's first democratically elected leader.

zh.s: 2021年9月5日，几内亚首都科纳克里发生枪击后，几内亚总统阿尔法·孔戴在政变中被本国武装部队逮捕。特种部队指挥官马马迪·敦布亚随后通过国家电视台宣布解散宪法和政府。几内亚经历数十年的威权统治后，孔戴是该国首位通过民主选举当选的领导人。

en.t: 2021 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final
en.s: The 2021 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final was the 48th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 2021 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship, an inter-county ladies' Gaelic football tournament for the county teams of Ireland. Dublin contested their 12th final, and were chasing 5 All-Ireland victories in a row after defeating Mayo in the 2021 semi-final.

zh.s: 2021年全爱尔兰高级女子足球锦标赛决赛是第48届全爱尔兰决赛，也是2021年全爱尔兰高级女子足球锦标赛的冠军决胜赛。这项赛事由爱尔兰各郡球队参加。都柏林队第12次打进决赛；在2021年半决赛击败梅奥队后，她们力争连续第五次夺冠。

en.s: The 2021 Daraa offensive was an offensive between rebel fighters and Syrian government forces in the Daraa Governorate, as part of the Daraa insurgency. The offensive saw heavy clashes throughout the governorate, particularly in the Daraa al-Balad neighborhood, which was besieged by government troops. The clashes were the fiercest Daraa had witnessed since the Syrian Army 2018 offensive.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in São Tomé and Príncipe on 18 July 2021. As no presidential candidate received a majority of the vote, a second round was originally scheduled to be held on 8 August 2021. However, following an objection to the first-round result, the second round was postponed to 29 August 2021, and later postponed again to 5 September 2021.

zh.t: 2021年圣多美和普林西比总统选举
zh.s: 圣多美和普林西比于2021年7月18日举行总统选举。由于没有候选人获得过半选票，原定于2021年8月8日举行的第二轮投票先被推迟。有人对首轮结果提出异议后，第二轮投票改期至2021年8月29日，随后又再次推迟至2021年9月5日。

en.s: A Mw 6.7 (Ms 6.8) earthquake struck Luding County in Sichuan province, China on 5 September 2022 at 12:52:19 local time. The epicenter was located 226 km (140 mi) from Chengdu, or 43 km (27 mi) southeast of Kangding. Ninety-three people died and 424 were injured. More than 13,000 homes and other infrastructure were damaged or destroyed. It was the largest earthquake to strike the province since 2017.

zh.s: 2022年9月5日当地时间12时52分19秒，中国四川省泸定县发生矩震级6.7级（面波震级6.8级）地震。震中距成都226公里（140英里），或位于康定东南43公里（27英里）处。地震造成93人死亡、424人受伤，超过1.3万栋房屋和其他基础设施受损或被毁。这是该省自2017年以来发生的最大地震。

en.t: Liz Truss is named leader of the UK Conservative Party
en.s: On September 5, 2022, the UK Conservative Party announced that its members had chosen Liz Truss as leader over Rishi Sunak. She won 57.4% of valid votes. Truss became prime minister the following day, after Queen Elizabeth II appointed her at Balmoral.
en.n: The leadership result was announced September 5, 2022; Truss became UK prime minister September 6.

zh.t: 利兹·特拉斯当选英国保守党党魁
zh.s: 2022年9月5日，英国保守党宣布党员投票结果：利兹·特拉斯击败里希·苏纳克，当选党魁，获得57.4%的有效选票。次日，英国女王伊丽莎白二世在巴尔莫勒尔堡任命特拉斯为首相。
zh.n: 党魁选举结果于9月5日公布；特拉斯在9月6日就任首相。

en.s: The election of the eighth Māori monarch took place from 3 to 5 September 2024, following the death of King Tūheitia. The Tekau-mā-rua (Tūheitia's privy council) convened a meeting of tribal leaders from throughout New Zealand to choose his successor by consensus. They chose Nga wai hono i te po, Tūheitia's youngest child and only daughter.

zh.s: 图黑提亚国王去世后，第八任毛利君主的选举于2024年9月3日至5日举行。图黑提亚的枢密委员会Tekau-mā-rua召集新西兰各地的部族领袖开会，以协商一致的方式选出继任者。他们选中了图黑提亚最小的孩子、也是唯一的女儿Nga Wai Hono i te Po。

en.s: General elections were held in the Autonomous Region of Bougainville on 5 September 2025 to elect the president and members of the House of Representatives. It was the first election in Bougainville to be held in a single day. A total of 46 seats were contested in the House of Representatives following the introduction of five single-member constituency seats.
